title: EIP-7708: ETH Transfers Emit a Log
quote: status: Last Call, last-call-deadline: 2026-11-01 [...] ETH transfers from smart contract wallets are not automatically logged anywhere. This has already led to problems in the past, eg. early exchanges would often not properly support deposits from smart contract wallets [...] A log, identical to a LOG3, is issued for: Any nonzero-value-transferring transaction to a different account, before any other logs created by EVM execution; [...] CALL [...] SELFDESTRUCT [...] CREATE or CREATE2 [...] address 0xfffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffe (SYSTEM_ADDRESS) [...] This matches the ERC-20 Transfer event definition. [...] Fee payment logs [...] would explode the log volume [...] Withdrawals [...] no natural emission point [...] ETH transfers already cost a minimum of 6700 gas, which is much more expensive than the LOG3 opcode (1500 gas). Hence, this EIP does not increase the worst-case number of logs

title: Update EIP-7708: cover contract-creation transactions and reverted frames (PR #12613)
quote: [opened 2026-11-02, open] Neither names a transaction with an empty to field, and EELS emits the log for it [...] The Specification section does not say what happens to the log when a frame fails [...] A creation that fails on an address collision emits no log [...] EIP-2780 folds the cost of this log into TX_VALUE_COST, and a contract-creation transaction pays no TX_VALUE_COST [...] In t8n the same creation uses 207,606 gas at value 0 and at value 7, with one log only at value 7. Is the log meant to be free too? [AI disclosure: an AI assistant helped find this issue]

title: internal/ethapi: avoid duplicate transfer logs in eth_simulateV1 post-Amsterdam (go-ethereum PR #35617)
quote: [merged 2026-10-07] With traceTransfers, every ether transfer is reported twice post-Amsterdam: once by the synthetic log and once by the protocol's EIP-7708 log arriving through the OnLog hook. Suppressing the synthetic one is resolution (a) of ethereum/execution-apis#868.
